summary: Lead Real Estate Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 25th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders, held on September 29, 2025. Shareholders approved a year-end dividend of 10 yen per share (total 136,419,000 yen), reappointed three directors (Eiji Nagahara, Hidekazu Hamagishi, Kenichi Homma), two audit committee members (Hiroyuki Saito, Ryoma Iida) plus an alternate (Hidenori Ihara), and appointed Ginga Audit Corporation as accounting auditor. No special-situation transaction—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring—was disclosed. This is a routine annual meeting notice under Japanese corporate law, filed as a foreign private issuer report on Form 6-K; no regulatory clock or risk arbitrage angle applies.
